statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Delayed NQ remains above the prior close but below its overnight high after a meaningful retracement, with no verified persistent no-retracement sequence.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is low while Stress remains extreme; the first post-holiday U.S. cash open is the principal conditional structure checkpoint.
headline: Nasdaq Tail drops to low as the overnight advance remains partly repaired
body: Delayed NQ was 29,666.25 at 05:07 UTC, about 56 points below the 29,722.75 overnight high while still above the 29,603.50 prior close. That repair and the lack of verified repeated failed pullbacks keep Tail low. Brent near $97.5, higher Treasury yields and renewed Gulf escalation keep Stress extreme, while Asian equity signals remain mixed.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding UTC clock-hours are available. Tail ranged 17%-24%, Stress remained 100%, and published modes shifted from event/whipsaw to mixed after the holiday reopen.
outlookSummary: The overnight advance remains partly repaired, keeping current Tail low despite extreme Stress. The principal conditional danger window is 13:20-15:00 UTC around the first post-holiday U.S. cash open; only persistent extreme-holding with failed pullbacks and renewed extension moves forecast Tail into the blocking band.
